entries.title: Passive readiness — HRV, sleep, and resting HR
entries.summary: The Coach now reads HRV, sleep, and resting heart rate from Apple Health as a zero-friction recovery prior. Your self-reported check-in still wins wherever you've logged one (self-reported measures outperform objective monitoring); passive signals fill the gap and, when strongly suppressed, prompt a quick check-in. Every passive claim is read as a rolling trend versus your own baseline, never a single noisy day.

entries.title: Bibliography — every study the Coach cites
entries.summary: The Coach Research Updates screen now includes a full bibliography of all peer-reviewed studies the coaching engine cites, ordered by author, each with a one-line explanation of why the Coach uses it and a direct link to the paper.

entries.title: Launch knowledge base
entries.summary: The initial Coach knowledge base: goal-based rep/load prescription, recovery-aware session eligibility, weekly volume landmarks, and RIR-based autoregulation — each grounded in the cited literature.
